content:
This PR fixes our definition of EpsilonNA by introducing LTS.SMTr, which corresponds to the multistep 'weak' transition relation in Sangiorgi's 'Introduction to Bisimulation and Coinduction'.
It also introduces some derived work (like a transformation of EpsilonNA into one with a single accept and terminating state) and generalises a bit TM tapes.

I'm separating this from cslib#615 because that contains a proposal for NTM that I feel still needs some discussion, whereas the above is much less controversial.

See cslib#625.
